title: Make gameplay-readiness findings actionable and fail-closable
description:
Finding sources:
- Codex readiness report still showed prose-only/mechanically shallow records across magic items, rules, equipment, features, and actions.
- ChatGPT found many deterministic mechanics gaps despite green verification.
- User policy: every audit finding must be addressed, even if broad or ambiguous.

Acceptance criteria:
- Readiness report categorizes each likely gameplay-mechanical record as modeled, accepted-prose-only, unsupported-with-reason, or finding.
- Add fail-closed mode for audit/freeze work.
- Ensure every finding bucket links to a bead or accepted non-issue rationale.
- Future audit should not rediscover the same broad bucket without an explicit tracked closure decision.
close_reason: PR #395: readiness report resolves every not-yet-modeled kind x bucket (unresolved-choice-prose/partial-structure/prose-only) against reviewed dispositions (accepted-prose-only/unsupported/finding->bead), fail-closed both ways via assertGameplayReadinessDispositions in the audit-bundle build: uncovered bucket or stale policy entry aborts; every finding links to its eshyra-o9bd.18.7.x modeling bead. Future audits cannot silently rediscover or lose a broad bucket.
